anomalies.description: A sudden, violent explosion occurs on the right side of the frame, producing a bright flash, rapidly expanding white smoke/dust cloud, and visible debris/structural fragments flying outward. The blast intensifies through frames f0–f5, with peak luminosity and particle ejection around f4–f5.

A person in a white shirt is violently struck or thrown backward by the explosion's force (visible from f6 onward), then lies amid debris, writhing, clutching their chest/abdomen, and showing signs of pain and distress (f7–f15). The individual appears incapacitated and vulnerable, with no indication of mutual combat; the assault is caused by the explosive event and its aftermath, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.
A shirtless man with face paint and a topknot appears in a confrontational stance, facing an off-screen opponent; smoke and motion blur suggest active physical combat or impact.

A live-action performer (E. Honda) in sumo-style makeup and attire engages in a staged martial arts performance, mimicking a fighting stance and motion against a projected animated opponent (Ken), with smoke effects enhancing the illusion of combat.

Two individuals engage in a choreographed martial arts fight sequence, involving high kicks, blocks, and rapid hand strikes across a bar-like setting; the motion blur and repeated impact poses confirm mutual physical combat.

Two individuals engage in a choreographed martial arts fight: one in a red outfit performs a high kick and exchanges blows with a shirtless opponent wearing red pants and sunglasses, who blocks and counters; motion blur and impact effects indicate physical contact.

Two shirtless individuals engage in rapid, close-quarters hand-to-hand combat with visible strikes, blocks, and dynamic motion blur indicating high-speed movement; the sequence shows repeated exchanges including punches, defensive gestures, and a high kick (f10–f12).

Two individuals in red outfits engage in close-quarters physical combat, with one delivering a high strike to the other; motion blur indicates rapid movement and impact.; A figure in red is thrown or falls across the ring floor, sliding and tumbling, while another figure remains standing; the sequence shows clear impact and follow-through of a combat move.
A shirtless male figure is shown in extreme close-up, appearing to be struck or recoiling violently; motion blur and facial distortion suggest direct physical impact during combat.
A character in red is struck by an off-screen force, causing a visible impact and motion blur consistent with being hit during a fight; the mural behind shows fighting figures, reinforcing context.

A shirtless man on the floor, with facial injuries (blood/makeup), repeatedly clutches his head in pain while lying prone under the feet of others (visible in mural and overhead perspective), indicating he is being attacked or tormented while helpless.
Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat: the person in the red/white jacket grabs the blue-jacketed person's arm, and they both move aggressively toward each other with contact evident.
